name: Vuk Borg-Agyeman
location: Meridian Station — central transit nexus, neutral ground, near State and Monroe
description:
Vuk Borg-Agyeman is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 40, she has the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on deman — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left her with skills and night terrors in equal measure. She works as a street samurai out of Meridian Station, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Vuk Borg-Agyeman is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
core_desires: Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
coping_mechanisms: Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
blind_spots: Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
psychology.secret: Vuk Borg-Agyeman has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "I don't get paid to have opinions about the target. I get paid to make them stop moving."
"Chrome doesn't make you faster. Training makes you faster. Chrome just means you survive learning."
"You want philosophy, hire a professor. You want someone dead by morning, hire me."

story_hooks: A crew member from Vuk Borg-Agyeman's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Vuk Borg-Agyeman's reputation — and a price for silence
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Vuk Borg-Agyeman owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: Vuk Borg-Agyeman functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on demand. Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

cyberware_inventory.name: Internal drug synthesizer
cyberware_inventory.description: Internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on demand

cyberware_inventory.name: Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement
cyberware_inventory.description: Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings

physical_description.build: Rawboned and lean with efficient musculature — no excess mass, built for speed and endurance rather than strength. Shoulders broad but not bulky. Wrists and ankles suggest long leverage rather than density.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with natural ash-blonde undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, no-nonsense braid or kept short and practical
physical_description.eye_color: Chrome iris rings with visible thermal overlay tech — inner iris shows subtle amber LED glow when augmentation is active
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium tan with warm undertones — mixed heritage visible in bone structure and coloration
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but maintained. Sharp cheekbones, narrow jawline. Skin shows controlled scarring and minute implant seam lines at temple and behind ear. No excess body fat. Grooming is methodical — nails cut to functional length, minimal jewelry.
distinguishing_marks: Pale surgical scar along left temple extending toward hairline — old cybernetic implant site, well-healed but visible
Thin white scar across the ridge of her right knuckles — old combat damage
Faint laser-burn marks along inner right forearm — weapons testing or accidental discharge from her own rig
Subcutaneous port seam visible below left collarbone under thin skin — drug synthesizer access point
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome iris rings are immediately visible — shimmer faintly in certain light. Subdermal implant seams visible at temple and collarbone. No visible limb replacements; augmentations are subtle and internal by design. The chrome is intentionally exposed rather than hidden — a message.
physical_description.posture_movement: Carries herself with coiled efficiency — shoulders loose, weight balanced on the balls of her feet. Moves with minimal wasted motion, head on a swivel. Eyes track threats automatically. Resting expression is neutral to hostile. When relaxed, there is a quality of a blade laid against a surface — still dangerous.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working specialist: functional combat wear in dark grays and blacks. Heavy-duty synth-leather jacket with reinforced panels and pockets for tools/gear. Articulated cargo pants with secure pockets and ankle reinforcement. Undershirt is smart-fabric base layer beneath. Footwear is tactical and broken in — non-descript dark boots with good grip. Wears a long tactical coat in winter. Minimal branding, maximum utility. Everything is maintained, nothing is flashy. The aesthetic is 'I need to move and fight' not 'look at me.'

image_prompt: Cyberpunk street samurai woman, age 40, Scandinavian-Ghanaian mixed heritage, tall and rawboned frame, steel gray hair in tight braid, sharp cheekbones, weathered face with intelligent expression. Glowing chrome iris rings with subtle amber LED glow in both eyes, thermal overlay visible. Visible subdermal implants at temple and collarbone, surgical scars on face and hands. Wearing dark tactical jacket with reinforced panels, smart-fabric base layer, articulated cargo pants, combat boots. Meridian Station interior background — neon-lit transit hub, night lighting, cool color palette. Posture is coiled and ready, weight on balls of feet, hands loose. Mood is dangerous but controlled, lethal professional competence. Cinematic lighting with harsh side-light emphasizing chrome and scars. Photorealistic cyberpunk aesthetic, gritty and grounded. --ar 2:3 --v 6
